triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: Alyosha, let me give you my blessing—a father’s blessing.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: When Fyodor Pavlovitch heard of this development in Smerdyakov he determined to make him his cook

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: The servants, Grigory and Smerdyakov, were standing by.

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: He was brought up by Grigory and Marfa, but the boy grew up “with no sense of gratitude,”

triples.subject: Marfa
triples.quote: He was brought up by Grigory and Marfa, but the boy grew up “with no sense of gratitude,”

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: Grigory taught him to read and write, and when he was twelve years old, began teaching him the Scriptures.

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: Grigory could not restrain himself. “I’ll show you where!” he cried, and gave the boy a violent slap on the cheek.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: sent him to Moscow to be trained. He spent some years there and came back remarkably changed in appearance.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: dropped in the muddy courtyard three hundred-rouble notes which he had only just received.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: Smerdyakov had picked them up and brought them in the day before.
